name: opencode-sidebar
description: OpenCode chat in the secondary sidebar, with active-file/selection context.

commands.title: OpenCode: Open Web UI in Browser

opencode.model.markdownDescription: Model used for new sessions, as `providerID/modelID`. A freshly spawned server otherwise defaults to an unauthenticated provider.

opencode.cliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `opencode.exe`. Leave empty to auto-detect.

opencode.autoAttach.enabled.description: Automatically attach the active editor file (or selection) to each prompt.

opencode.server.hostname.markdownDescription: Interface the server binds to and that the extension connects to. `127.0.0.1` keeps it loopback-only; use `0.0.0.0` (or a LAN address) to reach the web UI from another device.

opencode.server.port.markdownDescription: Port for the server. Defaults to `4096`, the port the OpenCode desktop app also uses. If it is taken, the extension connects to the server already there rather than failing. Set `0` to always pick a free port at random.

opencode.server.password.markdownDescription: Password for the server (Basic auth user `opencode`), stored in plain text in your settings and written to `~/.config/opencode/service.json`. Clear it to have opencode generate a random password each start.

opencode.attach.url.description: Attach to an already-running opencode server instead of spawning one (advanced).
